titleFa: پایه کوتاه نبود؛ پیچ شل بود
summaryFa: مهمان لقی صندلی را درست حس می‌کند، اما پیشنهاد کوتاه‌کردن پایه علت واقعی را حل نمی‌کند.
storyFa: در قاب راست صندلی زیر مهمان لق می‌زند و او کوتاه‌کردن پایه را پیشنهاد می‌دهد. در قاب چپ صاحب سبز علامت را می‌پذیرد و پیچ شل را پیدا می‌کند. پایین، همان یک صندلی را با پیچ‌گوشتی محکم می‌کند؛ مهمان با لبخند کنار آن ایستاده است.
meaningFa: درست‌بودنِ مشاهدهٔ یک مشکل به معنی درست‌بودن راه‌حل پیشنهادی نیست؛ شنیدن بازخورد باید آغاز بررسی علت باشد.
fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE NEW square narrative watercolor illustration for sentence 157 of an adult Persian illustrated wisdom book. Input image 1 is the APPROVED purple carpenter style/anatomy reference and input image 2 is the APPROVED eye/glint/cheek/lash reference. They are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets.
MEANING: A visitor correctly experiences a real problem, but their proposed fix is mistaken. The maker accepts the symptom without defensiveness and investigates the actual cause rather than blindly using the suggested remedy. Be concrete, warm and immediately readable.

LAYOUT: Three clear panels in a square: two equal panels across the top read RIGHT to LEFT, followed by one wider panel at the bottom. Same modest home dining corner, same simple wooden chair with four equal-length legs, same green owner and coral-red visitor. No extra cast.
TOP RIGHT: The coral visitor, seated normally in the wooden chair with both feet safely on the floor, feels the chair wobble. The chair is just slightly rocking, not collapsing. Small motion marks and an uneven seat angle make the symptom obvious. A small imagined saw next to one chair leg appears ONLY INSIDE the visitor's thought/speech bubble, with no physical cutting. The visitor says exactly, in one bubble: "صندلی لق می‌زنه؛ پایه‌شو کوتاه کن!" The green owner standing beside the chair listens with a kind concerned face and looks at the chair.
TOP LEFT: Both adults stand safely beside the SAME chair now turned on its side to expose its under-seat corner joint. Green crouches naturally, examines that joint with their face directed at it, and says exactly "لقه، درست می‌گی." One visibly loose metal SCREW in the corner brace directly beneath the seat has its head protruding and a gap between the wooden joints; this is the actual cause. All four legs remain equal length and uncut. The coral visitor looks at the SAME loose joint, not elsewhere.
BOTTOM WIDE: The green owner has tightened that screw with a normal screwdriver, which is still in their hand immediately beside the under-seat joint. The chair is upright, all FOUR EQUAL uncut legs on the flat floor, the coral visitor now STANDING to the right beside that SAME ONE chair, with an appreciative smile and both feet on the floor. There is exactly ONE chair in this bottom panel, no extra chair under the visitor. The green owner stands beside the stable chair and says exactly "مشکل از پیچش بود!" The SAME unused saw may rest safely on a high wall hook in the background; it must never touch the chair. Quiet joke: a big proposed operation was unnecessary; careful listening plus checking one tiny loose screw solved the real wobble. Do not ridicule the visitor. No red crosses, instruction numbers, trophy, English or extra text.

ART DIRECTION AND CHARACTER INVARIANTS: Match the attached approved book illustrations ONLY for character design and authentic restrained hand-painted watercolor, not their settings. Softly irregular broad overlapping transparent washes INSIDE the head, torso, arms, legs and hands, varying pigment density and subtle pooling, luminous paper; moderate watercolor strength. No colored-pencil or marker grain, no flat vector, no glossy 3D, no uniform embossed/crystalline texture. Contours are a darker shade of each character's own body color, not black. Every head is a simple true circle of equal width and height, never oval, no flattened chin, no ears/hair/nose. Head joins torso directly with NO NECK and a soft crescent of deeper local color under the head. Moderately built ADULT bodies exactly like the approved references: not chubby, not skinny, no bulging arms, no chibi. All bodies have the same simple neutral torso and pelvis, absolutely no breasts/bust, protruding buttocks, broad hips, pinched waist or gendered bulges. Female cue only two tiny fine upper-outer eyelashes on otherwise IDENTICAL small dark vertical oval eyes. Each dark eye MUST have one tiny reflected white glint INSIDE its dark shape; never white sclera around a pupil, never human eyeballs or frightening blank black eyes. Add subtle translucent diffuse rosy cheeks with soft watercolor edges, never flat pink discs. Minimal expressive brows and mouth. Exactly THREE fingers and ONE thumb on each visible hand (four digits total); anatomically coherent grips and limbs. No unmotivated selective clothing; aprons only if the occupation needs them. Identity and body color stay consistent in every panel.
COMPOSITION AND READABILITY: One complete square image, spacious book illustration with a clear cause and effect narrative. All full bodies, feet, hands and important objects stay completely inside the painting, never cropped at the bottom. Clean white outer paper margin, paint not touching file edges; vary natural airy watercolor vignette edges using a simple background ending naturally, no heavy black panel frames. Thin white gutters between panels. Horizontal sequences read RIGHT TO LEFT and vertical sequence TOP TO BOTTOM. Short accurate connected Persian RTL text only as specified, no English, no watermark, no captions explaining the moral. Bubble tails must point to the correct speaker. Purposeful sparse adult everyday setting, warm kind mood and gentle human wit. Every gaze, pointing hand and action must target its actual object; match perspective, physical contact and object continuity.

notesFa: تصویر نهایی واقعی پس از اصلاحِ حذف صندلی اضافه دیده شد؛ پایین فقط یک صندلی هست و مهمان ایستاده است.
پیشنهاد اره‌کردن صرفاً در حباب آمده؛ هیچ پایه‌ای بریده نشده و اره استفاده نمی‌شود.
پیچ شل در زیر صندلی و پیچ‌گوشتیِ روی همان اتصال روشن‌اند؛ سه مرحله علت و نتیجه دارند.
متن‌های فارسی صحیح‌اند؛ پاها کامل داخل تصویرند، چشم‌های باز برق کوچک دارند.

generationHistory.editPromptEnglish:
Use case: precise-object-edit. The supplied square three-panel watercolor comic has ONE narrative continuity mistake ONLY in the BOTTOM panel: it wrongly shows TWO CHAIRS, while the story is about the SAME ONE chair. Correct ONLY this.
Keep the TOP TWO PANELS absolutely unchanged: their characters, exact Persian dialogue, positions, chair inspection and loose screw. Keep the BOTTOM green character, screwdriver, EXACT "مشکل از پیچش بود!" bubble, the single chair currently being repaired, loose-screw plate and room background.
BOTTOM ONLY: REMOVE the extra chair UNDER the coral-red visitor. Red is now STANDING beside the ONE chair green is repairing, on the RIGHT side of the bottom panel, with BOTH FEET on the floor fully inside the frame. Red smiles gratefully and looks at the tightened screw; hands rest together naturally in front of their own neutral torso. Do not leave any second chair, seat, bench or wooden furniture leg behind/beneath red. The retained ONE chair has FOUR equal uncut legs resting on the floor, one seat and one backrest, the same chair design seen above. Green's screwdriver rests at the same under-seat screw. Do not add another chair. All character full bodies and feet inside white margins. Exact true-circle heads, tiny interior white eye glints, neutral adult bodies, layered watercolor, darker local body-colored outlines unchanged. No new text, no change of concept.

rootVisualReview.observations: Actual three panels show accurate wobble feedback, an unexecuted suggestion to saw a leg, inspection of a loose bolt, and tightening that bolt on the same single chair. Adviser stands in the final panel; no duplicate chair remains. Bodies and essential props fit.
